sloka: अथैनमुपसङ्गम्य हनुमान् वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।मम पृष्टं समारुह्य राक्षसं शास्तुमर्हसि ।। ६.५९.१२५ ।।।।
transliteration: athainamupasaṅgamya hanumān vākyamabravīt ।mama pṛṣṭaṁ samāruhya rākṣasaṁ śāstumarhasi ।। 6.59.125 ।।।।

translations.english: And then Hanuman submitted to Rama, "Just as Lord Vishnu mounted on mighty Garuda, you should also be mounted on my back and subdue Ravana."
